description: ipld/root_node.rs stores ArticleMetadata.newsgroups as Vec<String>. GroupName is a validated newtype that enforces RFC 3977 group name rules. By using Vec<String>, any code that reads a root node from IPFS gets unvalidated group names that could contain arbitrary content. The field should be Vec<GroupName> or the deserialization path should validate each string at read time.
title: core: newsgroups stored as Vec<String> in ArticleRootNode, not Vec<GroupName>; validation lost
